title: Speed around a free vortex
caption: Outside the core a vortex of circulation Γ = 2 m² s⁻¹ has v = Γ/2πr: the speed falls as 1/r, so the product v × r stays at 0.318 m² s⁻¹. At r = 0.1 m the speed is 3.2 m s⁻¹; at 0.2 m it halves to 1.6.
alt: Graph of speed against distance from the vortex axis, a 1/r curve passing through 3.2 metres per second at 0.1 metres.
description: The horizontal axis is distance r from the axis in m; the vertical axis is the speed v in m s⁻¹.
v = Γ/2πr = 2/(2πr). At r = 0.1 m, v = 3.2 m s⁻¹.
At r = 0.2 m, v = 1.59 m s⁻¹: doubling r halves v, so the circulation round every circle is the same.
